check_constraints.name: ck_approval_requests_execution_contract_version
check_constraints.sqltext: execution_contract_version IS NULL OR length(TRIM(BOTH FROM execution_contract_version)) > 0

check_constraints.name: ck_approval_requests_policy_status
check_constraints.sqltext: policy_decision::text = 'allow'::text AND risk_level::text = 'low'::text AND status::text = 'auto_approved'::text AND required_approval_count = 0 OR policy_decision::text = 'require_approval'::text AND (risk_level::text = 'critical'::text AND required_approval_count = 2 OR risk_level::text <> 'critical'::text AND required_approval_count = 1) AND (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'awaiting_second_approval'::character varying, 'approved'::character varying, 'rejected'::character varying, 'expired'::character varying]::text[]))

check_constraints.name: ck_approval_requests_risk_level
check_constraints.sqltext: risk_level::text = ANY (ARRAY['low'::character varying, 'medium'::character varying, 'high'::character varying, 'critical'::character varying]::text[])
